prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one tightly cropped dialogue portrait for a grounded medieval RPG.
Input images: Image 1 is Tor's existing identity and historically corrected costume only. Images 2 and 3 are approved Mara and Ivo PORTRAIT style masters. Match the latter's serious face anatomy, scale and hard pixel clusters, not the first image's oversized eyes/chibi head.
Primary request: Translate Tor (托雷, n1_tor) to a 74 pixels wide by 100 pixels high dialogue head portrait. Compose expressly for those coarse logical pixels. If the renderer uses a larger output, treat it as uniform nearest-neighbor enlargement of a 74x100 grid. DO NOT render high-frequency painting details for later shrinking.
Subject: a recognizable mature adult man with brown short side-parted hair and a compact full brown beard. Keep the lean slightly longer face, substantial narrow nose, brow ridge and cheekbones from his identity. His small deep-set eyes are naturally sized and inspect the listener slightly off toward viewer-left. One brow is subtly drawn inward, restrained attentive skepticism and weighing an explanation, not fury, villain smirk, sadness or youthful innocence. Closed even mouth clearly sits within the beard. Facial age shows through cheekbone/nose-side planes, a short brow crease and firm adult jaw, not deep elderly wrinkles. Dark brown eyes, subdued ivory only as tiny muted side slivers, no gleaming pupil highlights and no huge white eye blocks.
Framing: EXTREME CLOSE HEAD portrait. Crown just inside top, cheeks and beard occupy most of width, beard bottom near lower frame. Only a narrow sliver of collar at bottom, almost NO visible neck and no chest/shoulder expanse. Three-quarter head turn no more than approved Ivo. Organize hair into 4 or 5 broad solid matte locks, beard into 3 or 4 connected angular masses. No individual hair lines or noisy beard specks.
Costume visible at bottom only: weathered ordinary brown wool coat with simple straight overlapping front, charcoal tunic, a tiny off-white linen rounded/slit neckline. No folded lapels, pointed modern shirt collar, waistcoat, uniform, official badges, weapons or jewelry. He is a private debt collector, not a judge or official.
Medium: match approved Mara/Ivo hard-edge low-resolution pixel portrait. Strong warm near-black external silhouette contour; warm matte terracotta skin highlights and grouped medium/warm-brown shadows; clear nose bridge, nostril wings, cheekbone planes and lower lip. Max 32 visible colors for this batch, not photorealistic. Large contiguous clusters and purposeful stepped edges. No gradients, antialiasing, dither, grain, decorative detail or scattered bright pixels.
True transparent alpha outside silhouette. Single image, single person, no props, hands, book, text, border, frame, background, panels or UI.
